description:
Url cleaner
Just paste or share the unclean url in the app.
The INTERNET permission is to support unshorten function.
We use laststance/clean-url data to sanitize urls, they do have some inbuilt url expander but most websites have custom shortners.
NOTICE When using unshorten function, we have to use unclean url, thus meaning that you are being tracked, that's why that is an optional function.
